text.description_html:
Acorn AK1BI, 1-1/4 Offset Black Iron New York Shutter Hinges

Acorn's New York Shutter Hinges have a loose joint construction that allows shutters to be easily hung or removed. Hinge measures 4-1/4 inches vertical and 5 inches wide. Sold as set of 2 pairs, one pair for each side of the window. Comes with stainless steel screws. The Acorn AK1BI 1-1/4 inch offset hinge is for wood frame construction. The matte black finish is perfect for adding an old world feel to your shutters.

Features and Specifications of the New York Shutter Hinge:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Hinge Leaf Length: 4-1/4"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 5"
  • Pintle Plate Length: 3-1/8"
  • Pintle Plate Width: 1-1/8"
  • Offset: 1-1/4"
  • Reveal: 2-1/2"
  • For Wood Frame Construction
  • Packaged Includes: 2 pairs (4 hinges) and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Priced and sold as 2 pairs (4 hinges, one set for each shutter).
